items.title: MCPTotal Launches to Power Secure Enterprise MCP Workflows

items.title: ZDI-CAN-28085: Netgate
items.description: A CVSS score 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Alex Williams from Pellera Technologies' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-10-15, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-02-12 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
